نضطجع (form VIII)
# نَضْطَجِعُ (naḍṭajiʕu) /nadˤ.tˤa.d͡ʒi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِضْطَجَعَ (iḍṭajaʕa)
# نَضْطَجِعَ (naḍṭajiʕa) /nadˤ.tˤa.d͡ʒi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَجَعَ (iḍṭajaʕa)
# نَضْطَجِعْ (naḍṭajiʕ) /nadˤ.tˤa.d͡ʒiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِضْطَجَعَ (iḍṭajaʕa)
